teacher_sso_google.note: Google teacher SSO is shipped behind deployment flags; Microsoft and custom OIDC providers remain scaffolded.

teacher_sso_other_providers.toggle: Config parses for `microsoft` / `oidc_custom`, but start/callback routes still return explicit "not active yet" notices.
teacher_sso_other_providers.note: Microsoft and custom OIDC providers are scaffolded only and should not be treated as live auth paths.

classroom_kiosk_pwa.note: Student kiosk shell remains shipped behind an explicit feature flag.

rbac_scoped_grants.note: Scoped RBAC grants remain shipped but intentionally rollout-gated.

telemetry_db_split.note: Telemetry split scaffolding and evidence tooling are shipped, but final write-mode cutover remains intentionally deferred.

remote_helper_compute_control.note: Bounded paid remote helper compute stays off by default and is only used when the class-scoped remote state is `ready`.

csp.note: Repo-shipped env examples currently default to `DJANGO_CSP_MODE=report-only`; the Django code fallback remains `relaxed` when the setting is unset.

org_boundary.note: `REQUIRE_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_FOR_STAFF=1` is the production-safe baseline; local/day-1 presets may keep `0` for setup.

image_pins.note: Compose runtime images must use exact version tags or digests; full digest pinning is intentionally deferred.

container_scan.note: Security CI scans the built Class Hub and Homework Helper images for OS and library vulnerabilities.

private_llm_topology.note: Serious remote-LLM production posture is documented as: public LMS, private model host, helper-only server-to-server tailnet traffic, a Headscale-recommended control plane for createMPLS-style deployments, and a Gemma-family model as the recommended open-model example on the remote private host.

headscale_ops_bundle.note: Repo now ships a narrow Headscale control-plane ops bundle for createMPLS-style deployments: bootstrap, Compose stack, backup, restore, and systemd timer artifacts live under `ops/headscale/`.

remote_helper_compute_control.note: Helper now ships a staff-only bounded remote compute control for class sessions; provider control URLs stay server-side, the remote backend is used only when state is `ready`, and helper requests fall back to local/default mode when remote compute is off, not ready, or unavailable.
